Lemma
[Lower bound for the maximum value of a minimizer] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0052 ↗ lem:chow-iii-ch17-entropy-minimizer-equation 1. ch17:17.28\group Entropy Minimizers

For an entropy minimizer $w_\tau $ on a closed manifold, \[ \max _{\mathcal M}w_\tau \ge \exp \left(\frac\tau 2R_{\min }(g)-\frac n4\log (4\pi \tau ) -\frac n2-\frac12\mu (g,\tau )\right). \]
Proof

\sketch At a maximum point of $w_\tau $, one has $\Delta w_\tau \le 0$. Substitute this and $R\ge R_{\min }$ into the Euler–Lagrange equation and divide by the positive maximum value; solving the resulting inequality for $\log w_\tau $ gives the formula.

□
